name: GazeBubble
summary: A 3D gaze-pointing technique that adapts the bubble cursor mechanism to gaze-based target acquisition in virtual reality.
howItWorks: The user points with gaze, and the system applies a bubble-like selection mechanism around the gaze position to determine the most likely target. In dense scenes, an assistive interaction such as Diffuse can help separate or clarify candidate targets.
advantages: Hands-free selection of 3D targets in virtual reality, especially when gaze can quickly indicate the intended region or candidate target.
limitations: Gaze-based pointing can be affected by eye-tracking precision, visual attention demands, and ambiguity when many targets are close together.
